about: Known answers for the wallet transaction formats: calldata, deploy payload, gas, contract address, the signed preimage, a deterministic ML-DSA-65 signature (FIPS 204, rnd = 32 zero bytes, empty context) and the exact request body. Checked by the app (__tests__/TxBuilders.test.js), the extension (test/tx-builders.test.mjs) and the SDK.
